name: SSHI_FBR_Zener
rationale: The reference FBR failed due to low power (S4, S5, S6) and overvoltage (S3). Adding a parallel SSHI (Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor) flip circuit (L1 + S1) at the voltage extrema increases the energy extracted from the piezo capacitance, which should fix the undervoltage and startup issues. A Zener clamp (DZ33) on the output node prevents the voltage from exceeding 3.6 V in light-load conditions like S3.
